shellCommands.command: npm list 2>&1 | head; ls node_modules/.bin/next 2>&1 | head; cat package-lock.json | grep -A2 '"next"' | head -20
npm install next@latest react@latest react-dom@latest --save 2>&1 | tail -20
mkdir -p data app/books/[id] app/api/books/[id] lib 2>&1; echo "[]" > data/books.json; cat data/books.json

PORT=3456 npm start -- --port 3456 & sleep 5; curl -s http://localhost:3456/ | head -n 200; echo "---API GET books---"; curl -s http://localhost:3456/api/books; echo ""; echo "---POST---"; curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3456/api/books -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"title":"Test Book","author":"Jane Doe","notes":"Great book"}'; echo ""; sleep 1; echo "---GET after POST---"; curl -s http://localhost:3456/api/books | head -c 1000; echo ""; ID=$(curl -s http://localhost:3456/api/books | grep -o '"id":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4); echo "ID=$ID"; echo "--- detail page ---"; curl -s http://localhost:3456/books/$ID | head -n 100; echo "--- PATCH finished ---"; curl -s -X PATCH http://localhost:3456/api/books/$ID -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"status":"finished"}'; echo ""; echo "--- verify data file ---"; cat data/books.json; pkill -f "next start" || kill %1 || true; sleep 1; cat data/books.json

ls -R /workspace | grep -v node_modules | grep -v ".next" | head -n 80
echo "---package.json---"; cat /workspace/package.json
echo "---data---"; cat /workspace/data/books.json 2>&1
echo "[]" > /workspace/data/books.json; cat /workspace/data/books.json; pkill -f next 2>&1 || true; ps aux | grep next | head
